tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba'i go don bdud rtsi'i nying khu zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha mchog mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi chos skor spyi'i rnam gzhag khyad par rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi chos skor byung tshul/ skabs su babs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi don bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa mdo sngags gnyis su 'dus pa las 'dir sngags/ de la rgyud sde bzhi las/ 'dir bla med/ de la thabs shes gnyis med gsum las 'dir thabs rgyud/ de la 'dod chags can 'dul ba gsang 'dus/ zhe sdang can 'dul ba gshin rje gshed skor/ gti mug can 'dul ba rnam snang sgyu drwa rnams las/ 'dir gshin rje gshed kyi skor la/ dmar nag 'jigs gsum las dmar po bod du rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa dang / bcu dgu ba gnyis 'gyur/ bir+wa pa'i gzhung brgyad sogs bstan bcos kyang mang du 'gyur/ dbang bka' lha lnga dang bcu gsum ma gnyis/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len las tshogs sogs rgyas par bzhugs/ nag po la dgra gdong 'jigs gsum las/ 'dir spyi don gnyis pa 'jigs byed kyi skor la/ zhang lugs lha zhe dgu ma'i skor/ skyo lugs bcu bdun ma'i skor/ sa lugs lha dgu ma'i skor/ rwa lugs lha dgu/ lha bcu gsum ma gnyis/ 'dir rwa lugs lha dgu ma'i phyogs yin/ de yang lha dgu ni gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed/ phyag mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis/ ro langs brgyad dang bcas pa la lha dgu'am ro langs brgyad skor zer rgyud rtog bdun gyi dngos bstan rang yin/

de la rgya bod kyis sgrub thams rnams la/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang dpa' bo gcig pa gnyis su yod/ 'brog mi/ 'gos/ gnyen sogs kyis bsgyur ba ni deng sang bshad nyan cher mi snang / rwa lugs la rgya gzhung rnams ni rgyab rten du shin tu 'gro la/ rwa lo nyid kyi dkar chag tu thebs pa rnams la/ rwa pod du grags pa dang / rjes 'jug ldong rgya ston 'bri khung dpal 'dzin sogs kyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gsung sgros rnam bshad rdo rje myu gu/ rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma mkhas pa dpal gyi rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi cha bsdus pa ni thub bstan mkhan rin po che ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i rnam bshad 'di yin la/ 'dir de nyid gzhung mang bas 'dzin dka' bar/ 'dzangs par rten go don gal che ba rags rim 'chad pa'o/ /de la 'byung khungs lo rgyus kyi skabs na dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed skor gyi chos 'byung sar du mkhyen pa bcas dar rgyas che bas der blta/ gzhan yang 'jigs byed kyi rgya gzhung rnams dang bod gzhung rwa pod sogs da lta lung rgyun ma chad par bzhugs pas dbang lung gi don gnyer dang dpe gang 'byor rang gi lta rtog dang ma go ba'i gnas slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag las btsal te thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod par bya'o// //spyi don gsum pa skabs su bab pa'i sgrub thabs kyi don bshad pa la/ gang gi sgom pa'i gang zag gang du bsgom pa'i gnas/ nam bsgom pa'i dus/ gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing / dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sngags pas so/ /de yang 'dir rwa lugs ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang thob dgos la/ gzhan rang gang nyams su len pa'i dkyil 'khor de dang de'i dbang thob dgos te/

gcig tsam thob nas thams cad nyams len mi rung / dam tshig ldan pa yang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis ngo bo thob tshul gtong tshul nges shes skyes nas spang blang byed pa zhig dgos kyi dam tshig ci la zer cha med pa dag gi don mi 'grub pas/ 'di gal che ste/ rje btsun rin po ches/ 'di med 'gram rtsa zad pa'i khang rul bzhin/ /zhes gsungs/ rtog bdun las dam tshig ma nyams pa dang / rnam par rtog pa med pa dang / dam pa'i brtul zhugs can dang / dpa' bo bla ma la gus pa dul ba can zhes sogs gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ rtog bdun las/ de la gnas gsungs pa ni dur khrod dam/ chu klung gi 'gram mam zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs la/ las dang po pas 'du 'dzi dben zhing bsod snyoms rnyed bla chu la sogs pas nad mi bskyed pa sogs dang / brtan pa thob pas ni rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnas rnams so/ /bris 'bur la sogs pa'i bye brag gi rten 'byor na bsham ma 'byor na'ang skyon ni med/ bsnyen pa sogs la mchod gtor lag len bzhin bsham/ 'byor na 'og tu gdan khri dang bcas pa'i stan nang tshangs can 'bol ba/ ro gdan dngos ma grub kyang ro ras sogs la bris pa ste/ ro la bdag med pa bzhin sgrub pa po bdag med kyi don la goms 'dris byed pa'i dgos pa yod 'og tu rdul tshon gyis sna tshogs rdo rje bris pa'am ras g.yam pa sogs la bris kyang rung / bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas kha lhor blta/ gnas khang gis stabs kyi ma 'grig na lhor bltas par bsam pas kyang rung / dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs zhib tu bsam/ sems can thams cad pha mar shes pa'i byams snying rje bcos ma ma yin pa dgos so/ /de rnams rgyud la skyes pa'i rtags mi lus 'di nyin skar bzhin rnyed dka'/ dbul pos yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa'am/ long bas mig rnyed pa bas kyang don che/

de yun du mi gnas te/ de ring tsam yang mi 'chi ba'i gdeng med par shes nas snying 'dar yed yed pa/ tshe 'di'i snyan grags longs spyod sogs brag cha dang / gcan gzan gyi mdun du rtswa spungs pa lta bu da lta'i bde skyid tshe snga ma'i las su shes pas/ phyis gang yong da lta rang gi byed pa la rag las par shes nas/ dge sdig gi blang dor srog dang bsdos te ma nyams par byed pa zhig chos 'di'i sngon du mi dgos kha med yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ rtog bdun las mtshan phyed na/ zhes sogs gsungs pas/ srod tho rangs sogs thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs par ro/ /de dag gis ni sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang bar/ dbang thob cing sogs nas 'dug la zhes pa'i bar gyi don no/ /bzhi pa gang bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor la/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la mngon rtogs dngos bshad pa dang / de nyid rnal 'byor bla med kyi zab gnad dang sbyar ba gnyis/ dang po la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ sngon 'gro la yang thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rgya gar ba'i sgrub thabs sogs su tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa nas bsgom par gsungs pa ni rnal 'byor rnam bcu bar ma chad pa la dgongs/ da lta skyabs sems rdor sems bsgom bzlas mdzad pas de bshad na/ sngon 'gro gsum bya dgos ba'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pas/ sdom gsum cho gar mi ldan pas/ /sngags pa'i bdag nyid mi 'gyur te/ /zhes gsungs pas sngags par 'gyur ba la/ rang rang so so'i cho gas sdom pa gsum so so blang ba'am/ dbang bskur gyi cho ga gcig nyid las sdom gsum cig car thob kyang rung ste/ rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan par byas nas tshul bzhin du bsrung ba zhig dgos te/ gong du dam tshig dang ldan pa zhes pa dang don gcig

sngags sdom yin na sdom pa gsum char dang ldan dgos pas khyab bo/ /de la nyes pa chen po rnams ni dbang gis gso dgos/ thun bar gyi nyes pa chung ngu sbyong ba'i ched du so thar gyi sdom pa yar ldan du byed pa skyabs 'gro/ byang sems kyi sdom pa yar ldan du bya ba sems bskyed/ rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa'i nyes ltung rnams byin gyis rlob cing / ltung ba 'phel du mi bzhugs pa'i phyir/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams byas pas/ rang rgyud kyi sdom pa gsum yongs su dag par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ skyabs 'gro'i rnal 'byor/ sems bskyed kyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dang po ni/ spyir skyabs 'gro la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa du ma yod pa las/ 'dir thun mong ma yin pa bla med kyi skyabs 'gro nyams su len pa la/ sa phyogs dang gnas khang tha mal du 'dzin pa stong nyid du yal nas/ bai ḍūr+ya sogs rin po che las grub pa'i dag pa'i zhing du mos pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gi rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skur bsam/ 'di la bla ma chos 'brel yod tshad dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad 'dus par bsgom/ de'i rgyab tu rin po che'i khri steng po ti brag ri brtsigs pa lta bu bsam/ de lung rtogs kyi chos thams cad kyi ngo bor bsgom/ mtha' skor du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs par mos de la dge 'dun dkon mchog thams cad ma lus par 'dus par bsgom/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba drin can mar gyur pa ni nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa rnams rang gi nye 'khor na sa chen po'i rdul bzhin yod par bsam/ khyad par rtsa ba'i pha ma dang gnod byed dgra 'dre byur gsum rnams rang gi mdun du gsal btab/

rang gi skyabs 'gro byed pa bzhin de thams cad kyis byed par bsam/ dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po zhes sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob bar gyi skyabs mgon re sa bla ma dkon mchog las med par thag rbad bcad nas skyabs su 'gro de snying rje dang dad pa gal che/ sems ma yengs par dpal ldan bla ma sogs dang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs kyi gtso bo la dmigs/ dam pa'i chos sogs kyi chos la dmigs/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun sogs la dge 'dun la/ kha tsam tshig tsam min par blo khel nges kyi ci nus bya/ mjug tu bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs kyi gsol ba btab pas/ 'khor rnams 'od zer dkar po zhu nas/ rang gi spyi bor thim/ chos po ti 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas mgrin par༞ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par zhu nas snying gar thim pas/ rang gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med du bsam/ 'di la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyang tshang / cung zhig sems glod la mnyam par bzhag gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad bdag gi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med la pha ma byas res kyis phan btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pas/ drin can 'di rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por mtha' yas pa'i sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba rnams snying re rje snyam du yang yang bsam la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sogs snying thag pa nas gsum la sogs mang du brjod/ gsum pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas spyir bshad pa dang / bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de la gshin rje gshed bskor ba rnams/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying gar hūm̐ yig gi mthar yig brgyas bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdus byas/ de dag las bdud rtsi dkar po babs pas rang gi lus gang nas/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnams 'og sgo dang mthe'u chung gnyis nas thon par bsam nas/

ya man+ta ka bzhi sbyor gyi yig brgya bzla ba lugs gcig go /da lta phyag len la ma rgyud pa a bhi da na ltar dang / pha rgyud pa klu byang gi mi bskyod pa'i dkyil chog dang / nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i mchod chog ltar mdzad/ gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la lha sgom pa/ sngags bzla ba bshags sdom bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs pad+ma dang zhes sogs ngag 'don bzhin no/ /'di la dbu rgyan rang 'dra rang chas su sgom/ che chung tshon gang sogs yid yul du gang bde bla ma dang dbyer med do/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa/ bzlas rgyu'i sngags/ ji tsam bzlas pa'i grangs so/ /dang po ni/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i sogs dkyus bzhin/ gnyis pa ni/ yig brgya du ma zhig yod kyang 'dir yo ga'i rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa bzhin byed/ sngags don ni/ oṃ ni rdo rje gsum ldan/ bsod nams len dang / bkra shis sogs mang po la 'jug badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ lha la 'bod pa'o/ /rdo rje shes rab stong pa/ sems dpa' snying rje bde chen te zung 'jug gi sku'o/ /sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya ni dam tshig rjes su skyongs shig pa'o/ /badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis nye bar gnas pa'am bzhugs su gsol/ ḍī ḍho brtan pa me bdag la bha wa mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu dges par mdzod/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu rgyas par mdzod/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ bdag la shin tu chags par mdzod/ ces par 'gyur/ sarba thams cad/ sid+dhi dngos grub/ 'di yan yi ge lnga bcu/ man lnga bcu/ me bdag la/ pra rab tu/ ya ts+tsha stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ las kun la yang bdag gi ni/ tsi taṃ shrā+eḥya ku ru hūm̐/ sems la dge legs su ni mdzod/ ha ha ha ha/ dga' bas dgod pa/ ho bha ga wan kye bcom ldan 'das/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje/

ma me bdag la muñtsa grol bar/ badz+ri bha wa rdo rje can du gyur cig gi mahā sa ma ya satwa/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ stong nyid rnam kun mchog ldan no/ /gsum pa grangs ni/ bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum/ thun re nyer gcig sogs so/ /gsum pa bshags sdom ni thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod de sogs te/ bshags pa la stobs bzhi tshang dgos pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rten gyi stobs/ dam tshig nyams chag ma lus pa 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad sdig pa srog la babs kyang mi bya snyam pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ 'di gal che ste/ de ltar byas pas sdig pa 'dag nges snyam pa sor chud pa'i stobs te bzhi'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dag par byas yod/ zhes gsung lhang byung nas rang la thim pas sogs don dam par bshags bya 'chags byed sogs mi dmigs pa brjod bral la blo bzhag go /gsum pa dgos pa ni/ de ltar thun mong gi sngon 'gro gsum byas pas/ sdom gsum gyi nyes pa phra mo rnams dag cing lha mi'i mchod gnas su 'gyur ba dang bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /sgrub thabs las skyabs 'gro sogs nas/ mthun par byas nas zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ yul dag pa la brten pa'i tshogs bsag ma dag pa la brten pa'i tshogs bsag de dag gi dgos pa bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ tshogs bsag zhing spyan drangs/ de la phyag mchod pa bya ba/ de'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba/ gnang ba nod de gshegs su gsol ba'o// dang po ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje 'jigs byed ces sogs te/ rwa los rang skad cig gis pad+ma dang nyi ma ma he la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/

g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i ma he nag po'i rwa bar dang / g.yon brkyangs pas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ gcer bu ling ga gyen du rgyas shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ljags 'dril ba mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gsal btab/ dgos pa ni/ tha mal rnam rtog bzlog bar chad bsrung / lhas lha la tshogs bsag pa'i tshogs myur du rdzogs pa'o/ /thugs ka ste nu ma gnyis kyi bar lus kyi nang gi dbus drang por pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po gsal btab/ de las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa rtse mo lcags kyu ltar dgug pa grangs med pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas spyan 'dren/ sngags oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sngags kyi 'go 'dren pa sogs mang po la 'jug badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dam tshig gis 'dir byon/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya lha'i rigs kyi blo gros kyis gur 'grel las/ rdo rje se gol sbyor ba yi/ /zhes bya ba ni/ lag pa gnyis dpung mgor rdo rje bcing ba byas la sogs nas/ mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar bkug nas/ mthe bong dang gung mo se gol sbyor ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa de la phyag mchod bya ba ni/ phyag la 'dir tshig nyung don rgyas/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥni/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ na maḥshrī badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal la bh+yaḥni/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod pa ni rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ las sprul pa'i lha mo sgeg sogs brgyad/ me tog ma la sogs pa lnga rang rang gi phyag mtshan mchod rdzas 'dzin pa sprul la/ de dag re re la'ang grangs med par gyur te/ mdun gyi tshogs zhing gi mtha' bskor du 'khod nas mchod par bsam ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/

oṃ badz+ra la se sogs kyi sgeg mo dkar mo/ phreng ba ma ser mo/ glu ma dmar mo/ gar ma ljang khu/ bdug spos ma dkar mo/ me tog ma ser mo/ mar me ma dmar skya/ dri chab ma ljang khu rnams kyis mchod par bsam/ sngags rnams bod skad du bsgyur ba sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad po de yin/ de tsam mi nus na oṃ sarba sogs nyer mchod lngas mchod/ mthar mchod pa'i lha mo rnams mchod yul dpal chen po rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi thugs kar thim pas mnyes par bsam mo/ /gsum pa de yi spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ yan lag bdun pa la rigs mang yang / 'dir gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags dang / saṃ bu ṭa nas 'byung ba'i sdom bzung lan gsum gsum bya bar gsungs pas/ 'di la gnyis/ yan lag bdun pa bshad pa dang / rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ 'dir yan lag bdun ni/ sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag dge ba la rjes su yid rang ba'i yan lag don dam byang sems bzung ba'i yan lag skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag smon pa sems bskyed pa'i yan lag 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i yan lag bsngo ba'i yan lag ste/ de dag gzhung tshig dang sbyar na/ sdig bshags ni dkon mchog gsum la sogs tshig rkang gnyis te/ tshig dang pos rten gyi stobs te mdun gyi tshogs zhing ngo / /tshig rkang gnyis pas rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs te/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag pos bshags pa'o/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa dang sor chud pa'o/ /sngags rdor sems kyi bshags sdom du bshad pa ltar te shugs la bstan to/ /rjes su yi rang ni/ 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang zhes pa ste/ rang gzhan gyi dge rtsa la phrag dog med par dga' ba bsgom pa'o/ /don dam byang sems ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung zhes pa ste/ spros bral bsgom par dam bca' ba'o/ /skyabs 'gro ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang / zhes sogs tshig gnyis/ smon sems ni/

rang gzhan don ni sogs tshig gnyis/ 'jug sems ni/ byang chub mchog gi sogs tshig gsum/ bsngo ba ni/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces so/ /tshig don de dag blo dang 'dres par lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni sras bcas sangs rgyas zhes sogs te/ tshigs bcad dang po'i tshig rkang gnyis kyi sdom pa bzung ba'i yul dang / de nas gcig gi bzung ba po'i gang zag dang / de nas gnyis kyis dus bstan to/ /ji ltar dus gsum zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis smon pa sems bskyed dang / tshul khrims kyis ni sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis 'jug pa sems bskyed bstan te/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig go /so so'i dam tshig la/ rnam snang / mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung / 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyi sdom bzung sh+lo ka re re'o/ /byang chub sems ni zhes pa man gyi mdor bsdus nas bzung ba bstan pas/ sdom bzung 'di yan lag bdun pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed du 'du bar gsungs la/ 'di sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs kyi sdom pa yar 'phel du byed par rje btsun mchog gis gsungs so/ /bzhi pa snang ba nod pa ni/ de ltar rgyun bshags byas pas tshogs rten de dag gis zhal nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyis mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i skal ba yod pas lam rim pa gnyis sgoms shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo/ /tshogs zhing gshegs su gsol ba'am/ mi dmigs pa gang rung bya'o/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la rten pa'i tshogs bsags ni/ yul sems can rnams dmigs yul du byas nas bsgom pas so/ /de'ang sems can tshad med pa'i bsod nams kyang tshad med pa'o/ /bzhi ni byams pa dang / snying rje dang / dga' ba dang / btang snyoms so/ /'di sgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug gis tshangs pa sangs rgyas dang / gnas skabs su lha tshangs pa'i go 'phang thob pas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi yang zer/ sgom tshul ni/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs/ bzhi po snying thag pa nas bsgom mo/ /gsum pa de'i dgos pa ni/ de ltar byas pas rang gi rgyud rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / mtha' yas pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod la/ bskal pa grangs med gsum la sogs par tshogs bsags pa de nyid rnal 'byor pas stan thog gcig tu nyams su len pa'o/ /yang / tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod/ 'og tu stong nyid bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs dang / 'di bsod nams kyi tshogs te/ rgyu tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu bsgrub pa la 'bras bu rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed nas sems can gyi don sgrub pa'i nyams len no/ /gdong drug gi rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i tshe na yang / /byams dang snying rje dga' btang snyoms/ /tshad med bzhi yi rim pa yis/ /sems can rnams la phan gdags te/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rnams/ /yod min med min gnyis ka min/ /gnyis ka med pa'ang ma yin te/ /spros bral ngo bo med par bsgom/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā zhes sogs tshad med bzhi'i rjes thogs de ma thag tu ye shes tshogs bsag bsgom par bshad/ gzhung gzhan nas kyang 'byung bas/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa la gnyis te/ dngos dang de'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtog bdun las/ chos thams cad bdag med par sngon du song bas lha'i dmigs pa bya ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā zhes sogs te/ sngags don ni/ oṃ ni dam bca' ba/ shu n+ya tā stong pa nyid/ dzñā na ye shes/ badz+ra rdo rje/ swa bha wa rang bzhin at+ma ko haṃ 'di nyid nga'o/ gsal stong zung 'jug de nyid la zhes pa'i tha snyad byas pa'o/ /zhes sngags brjod pas/ rang gi phung khams skye mched phyi rol ri rwa ba khang khyim sogs snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid du sangs kyis bsgom/

gnyis pa dgos pa ni/ sngar gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang / ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba'i ched dang / ye shes kyi tshogs kyi chos sku nyams su blangs nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzugs kyi sku bsgom pas sku gnyis zung 'jug tu 'gyur ba dang / rdo sogs rags pa ma bsal na myu gu skye ba'i skabs med pa bzhin du/ tha mal gyi snang ba ma bsal na lha bskyed pa'i skabs med pas lha bskyed pa'i dgos pa dang gsum yod pa gsungs so// ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa dang / de la mchod bstod bya ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la srung ba'i 'khor lo sgom pa/ gzhal yas khang bsgom pa/ dur khrod bsgom pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs te/ der sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu zhes pa'i don ni/ sangs rgyas rnams chos sku spros bral mngon du mdzad kyang / de kho na'i ngang du mi gnas par snying rjes zhi ba mya ngan las 'das ba'i mtha' mnan pa'i sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam rjes su dran nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir gzugs kyi skur bstan zhes pa'i don no/ /lung ni la li ta sogs kyi rgya gzhung mang por snang la sgrub thabs thams cad la 'gre'o/ /rang gi sems gsal ba'i rgyun paṃ du bskyed/ de sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ de steng raṃ las nyi dkyil/ de steng hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og rdo rje sngon po'i sa gzhi nas phung brdal ba lta bu/ rwa ba ni khro bo'i rdo rje nag po gyen du 'greng ba bsgrigs pa las grub pa dbyibs zlum por yod pa/ gur ni/ rwa ba'i nang du gur gyi rnam pa can zlum po ste/ phyogs mtshams su rwa ba dang gur gyi nang sbrags pa'o/

/rwa ba'i thad dang mnyam pa'i gur nang du/ rdo rje'i bla re bres pa/ rwa gur de dag las phyir 'phros pa'i me ri 'bar bas bskor bar bsam/ de yang sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar sogs phyogs mdog yin zhing / srung 'khor shin tu yangs pa blos 'khyud tshad du bsgom/ brtan byed oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sogs gsum brjod pa bdag dang gnas dang / rnal 'byor gsum bsrung ba'o/ /brjod tshul chos nyid rang sgrar grags pa'o/ /sngags don ni/ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rdo rje srungs srungs/ hūm̐ gsum sku gsung thugs mi phyed pa phaṭa gdug pa can rnams 'joms pa'i don no/ /rnal 'byor bsrung ba ni/ nyams su blang bya'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad bsrung ba'o/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi sogs su bsgom pa ni ngo bo nyid stong nyid gzugs rnams rdo rjer langs pa mtshon no/ /dgos pa bdud dang bar chad zhi bar dgra nag sogs las gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gzhal yas khang bsgom pa ni/ rtog bdun las/ nam mkha'i dkyil du yaṃ las grub pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor mdog du ba'i rnam par bsam mo/ /zhes gsungs/ saṃ bu ṭa'i 'jigs byed kyi skabs su/ bha ga'i nang du yaṃ la sogs gsungs pa'i don srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyis 'byung gnas sogs gzhan du chos 'byung dkar po sogs bsgom pa yod na'ang / 'dir gdug pa can gdul ba'i don du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba bsgom/ de nang rlung dkyil ni dbyibs ting phor sgong gzugs ma chus bskang ba lta bu/ de steng khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho'i dbus su mi mgo skam po'i gzhal yas khang bsgom pa drag po'i gzhal yang khang gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /'di sngon byung bcom ldan 'das kyi bdud dang log 'dren bsgral tshul dang yang mthun no/ /mi mgo rnams skam po kha phyir bstan nas brtsigs pa'o/ /byang phyogs so bdun mtshon don no/ /byang phyogs so bdun chos sku'i yon tan yin la/

'di mi mgo skam po re res kyang chos sku mtshon zhing / zlum po dang sgo gcig pas chos thams cad chos sku'i de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa mtshon la/ chos sku'i mtshon byed de nyid las chos sku'i yon tan byang phyogs sogs kyi mtshon don ngo bo'i sgo nas tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /rwa los bcu gsum mar thod skam gyi rwa ba'i sgo la sgo 'khyud la sogs pa gsungs pas 'dir yang dgos pa 'dra'o/ /khrag zhag gis ni chos sku snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral ba dang 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa mtshon/ gsum pa dur khrod bsgom pa ni/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol tu dur khrod chen po brgyad sogs so/ /'di dag ni kyai rdor sogs dang yang 'dra'o/ /ro gnas pa'i sa yin pas dur khrod ces bya la/ pha rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor rnams la dur khrod mi 'byung yang / 'dir gdug pa can rnams gsod gcod kyi las byed pa'i gnas la dgongs te/ rtog bdun gyi bris sku'i rtog pa dang / saṃ bu ṭar gsal bar gsungs so/ /gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa bzhi ste/ mngon byang las dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab ba/ ye shes pa bcug ste sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtog bdun las/ nam mkha'i dkyil du zhes sogs nas me ltar 'bar ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs pa'i don/ mngon par byang chub pa lnga las rdo rje 'jigs byed bskyed pa dang / de ltar bskyed pa'i zhal phyag sogs zhib par bshad pa las/ dang po la ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang / de la shes byed 'god pa gnyis las/ dang po la mngon par byang chub pa lnga ste/ mngon byang dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes dang / gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / gsum pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang / bzhi pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes dang / lnga pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnams so/

/de la mngon byang dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i zhes sogs nas/ de'i thugs kar āḥyig ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor zhes pa'i bar ro/ /nyi dkyil thugs khar zer yang mdun du bsgom pa sbyang gzhi dang mthun gsung ngo / /de ltar 'jam dpal bskyed pa ni rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs/ gong gi pad+ma 'dab ma stong ldan ni rgyu 'bras kyi lha gnyis ka'i gdan yin pas mi 'gyur bar gnas/ zla ba ni 'jam dpal gyi gdan yin yang / gdan du gnas par bya ba ma yin te/ 'jam dpal dang lhan cig tu thugs kha'i nyi mar thim rgyu yin/ mngon byang gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sogs nas/ 'od kyi phung po chen por gyur zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de'i tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kha nas gshin rje gshed kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi ma dang bdag nyid 'jam dbyangs su gsal ba la thim pa'i rkyen gyis sngar bshad pa ltar gdan zla ba dang / 'jam dbyangs dang nyi ma dang bcas pa thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres te 'od kyi gong bu'am/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od zer brgya stong 'bar bar bsam par bya'o/ /nyi ma 'di ni 'og gi lha'i gdan du'ang gnas so/ /mngon byang gsum pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes ni/ 'od phung de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros sogs nas/ hūm̐ gi yi ge mthing nag chen po zhig tu gyur zhes pa'i bar ro/ /'dir de ltar thim pa'i rkyen gyis 'od phung las hūm̐ mthing nag chen po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba zhig tu gyur par bsam/ 'od phung byin gdan nyi dkyil du gnas so/ /mngon byang bzhi pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas/ lte ba'i hūm̐ gis mtshan pa gcig tu gyur zhes pa'i bar ro/ /mngon byang lnga pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni/

rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ de las 'od zer sogs nas bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed du gyur pa ni/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur pa ni/ snod bcud sbyong ba yin la/ kyai rdor dang yang mthun/ gsang 'dus pas 'gro ba dbang bskur/ bde mchog pa'i gzhi sbyang bsgyur sogs bla med thams cad sgrub thabs kyi skabs cung zad mi 'dra ba ma gtogs gnad 'dra'o/ /de rnams la rwa los sku gsung thugs kyi zhing khams dag pa zhes gsung / de ltar zhi ba rgyu'i 'jam dpal dang 'od zer spro bsdu rnams dang 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa khro bo'i skur bskyed pa'i dgos pa ni/ gdul bya zhi bas 'dul ba dang / des mi 'dul ba la drag po'i skur bzhengs par mi bskyod pa'i 'grel par gsungs/ sngon byung dang yang mthun no/ /gnyis pa de la shes byed dgod pa la gnyis te/ dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i mngon byang dang mthun pa'i bshad pa dang / rgyud gzhung gzhan nas gsungs pa'i don tshang bar bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dgra nag le'u bcu bdun par/ rnam pa lnga ni bsgom byas la/ /zhes sogs kyi 'grel par dpal 'dzin gyis/ mngon byang lnga gsal bar bshad/ mngon byang dang po zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes ni/ gdan gyi zla ba'o/ /ci'i phyir zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes zhes bya zhe na/ chos thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ba me long dang 'dra bas me long lta bu ste/ ye shes grub pa las/ ji ltar gzugs brnyan me long la/ /rang nyid nges par snang ba bzhin/ /de bzhin chos sku'i ye shes ni/ /snang ba'i me long zhes bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la gzugs phung dang kun gzhi dag pa'o/ /rnam pa zla ba bsgom pa rnam pa lam byed/ de la me long ye shes su mos pa lam byed/ des bdag gi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs shing byin gyis brlabs pas byin rlabs lam byed/ des 'bras bu thob pas 'bras bu lam byed de/

lam byed bzhi po lam thams cad la sbyor tshul shes dgos so/ /mngon byang gnyis pa nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes ni/ ye shes gang gis chos thams cad mnyam nyid du rtogs pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs kun ye shes te/ /rang gi ngang gis 'gro ba yi/ /dngos nyid gcig par thugs chud nas/ /mnyam nyid ye shes zhes bya'o/ /zhes so/ /ye shes de ni tshor ba'i phung po dang nyon yid dag pa'o/ /rnam pa nyi mar bsgom pa sogs lam byed bzhi sbyar/ mngon byang gsum pa sor rtog ye shes/ 'od zer gyi sngags rnams spyan drangs te thim pas hūm̐ yig sngon po 'od zer lnga ldan te/ ci'i phyir so sor rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya zhe na/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bas shes bya thams cad ma 'dres par mkhyen pa ste/ gdod nas dag cing skye ba med/ /rang bzhin gyi ni 'od gsal ba/ /phan tshun khyab pa'i ye shes bas/ /so sor rtog pa can zhes bshad/ /ces so/ /de nyid 'du shes kyi phung po dang yid kyi rnam shes dag pa'o/ /ci'i phyir yig 'brur sgom snyam na/ yig 'bru dang 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /mngon byang bzhi pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes phyag mtshan rdo rje hūm̐ bcas bsgom pa ni/ ci'i phyir bya ba'i grub pa'i ye shes zhes bya zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa ro gcig pa ste/ kun tu kun nas sangs rgyas kyi/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa la 'jug pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mdzad gcig pas/ /bya ba grub pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ /de nyid 'du byed kyi phung po dang sgo lnga'i rnam shes dag pa sogs 'dra/ mngon byang lnga pa tshos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i spro bsdu las khro bo'i sku yongs rdzogs su bsgom pa ste/ mngon byang lnga po 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi bskyed rim gal che shos yin pas bshad pa rgyas par kye rdor rnam bshad sogs su blta/ 'dir snod bcud sbyang ba mngon byang lnga pa'i skabs su 'byung ba rtog bdun las/

sems can yongs su smin par btul nas byang chub la rab tu 'god do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /mngon byang lnga pa la ci'i phyir chos dbyings ye shes zhes bya zhe na/ chos ni phung po lnga'i bdag nyid dam sgrib pa thams cad do/ /de dag gi dbyings ni rgyu'o/ /de gang zhe na/ spros pa dang bral ba'o/ /yang na chos ni sangs rgyas kyi chos so/ /dbyings ni rgyu'o/ /de'i sgrib pa thams cad las grol ba ste/ gang tshe nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib/ /thams cad las grol de'i tshe/ /rnam pa mchog gi rdo rje can/ /shin tu rnam dag ces bshad do/ /zhes so/ /de nyid rnam shes kyi phung po dang / /byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ /de ni sku rdzogs pa dang chos mthun te ye shes thams cad rdzogs pa'o/ /rdo rje rtse mo gshed dmar/ gdong drug sogs rgyud sde mang po'i mngon byang 'dir gsal lo/ /dbyangs gsal thim pas mtshan dpa'i sa bon dang / dhīḥlas 'jam dpal bar do sbyong byed dang pha ma'i ting nge 'dzin yang ngo / /go rim dang rnam pa cung zad mi 'dra yang / don kye rdor ye shes zhabs jo bo rje'i gsang 'dus spyan ras gzigs sogs bla med kun gnad mthun/ sngags rnams thim tshul bde mchog gi sgra tshul dang mthun/ 'od phung gi sgong skyes sogs rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i lha'i bskyed chog 'di ni bla med kyi rgyud rnams las gsungs pa'i mngon byang lnga sogs thams cad tshang zhing khyab par snang bas rmad du byung ba'i lam srol du shes par bya'o/ /mngon byang rgyu rdor 'dzin dang / dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la sbyar ba gnyis las 'dir phyi ma'o/ /gnyis pa de ltar bskyed pa'i zhal phyag sogs zhib par bshad pa ni/ rtog bdun las tshig lhug tu gsungs pa/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas tshigs bcad du bsdebs par mdzad pa'i don 'grel ba la/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/

/zhes sogs te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku ni rje btsun 'jam dpa'i dbyangs yin la de nyid gdug pa 'dul ba'i don du thugs rje chen po'i khro bo'i skur gyur pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed ces bya ste 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje'i gshed/ ces dang / 'jam dpal gsang rgyud las/ de mthong nas ni khro bo gzhan/ /thams cad kun gyi lag cha shor/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ de la rdo rje 'jigs byed ces pa'i mtshan don ni/ rdo rje stong pa nyid de/ sra zhing snying po khong stong med pa sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'o/ /'jigs byed ni dmigs med snying rje byang chub kyi sems so/ /de ltar stong nyid snying rje dbyer med de gzugs rnams gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir/ khro bo drag po'i skur bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ zhal gyi rnam pa ji ltar yin pa dbu rgyan dang bcas pa/ phyag gi gyes tshul ji ltar yin pa phyag mtshan dang bcas pa/ zhabs kyi dod tshul ji ltar yin pa srog chags dang bcas pa/ sku'i rgyan cha ji ltar yod pa ling ga dang bcas pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu ji ltar yin pa 'phros gzhan dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal gyi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ la li ta'i gzhung chung ngam/ 'ga' zhig tu slob dpon a bos zer ba'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ rje tsong kha pa'i bzhed pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ la li ta'i zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs sogs dang / skyob pa rnams dang rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi bzhed pa'i 'khor zhal dang / gsum pa ni/ rwa los bzhed pa brtsegs zhal te/ da lan skabs su bab pa de bshad na/ rwa los bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su/ rwa'i g.yas su dang po sngon po mche ba gtsigs pa/ de'i steng du gnyis pa dmar po ljags 'dril ba/ de'i steng na gsum pa ser po khro gnyer gtsigs pa/ rwa'i g.yon gyi zhal gsum dkar po dang dud kha nag po gsum brtsegs pa/

zhes gsungs pas/ g.yas g.yon gyi zhal gsum po rwa g.yas g.yon gyi ldebs la yar brtsegs nas yod pa'i zhal steng ma'i steng tsam du/ rwa'i rtse mo thon pa tsam bzhed/ bris sku 'ga' re sogs la/ zhal dang po gnyis ma he zhal gyi g.yas g.yon dang / de steng srin zhal gyi g.yas g.yon de steng 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi g.yas g.yon du sbyar ba snang yang / lugs 'di la mi 'byor te/ de ltar rwa'i g.yas kyi zhal gsum zhes sogs mi 'thad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na skabs 'dir brtsegs zhal snga ma ltar bzhed do/ /des na g.yas kyi zhal tho brtsegs kyi rnam pa dang / g.yon gyi zhal gsum tho brtsegs kyi rnam pa dang / dbus kyi zhal gsum yang tho brtsegs kyi rnam par bsgom mo/ /dpe la lar mdog nag rab khros 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhes dang / kha cig tu sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs chen po/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar byas kyang legs la/ dpe mang por sku mdog gi gsal ka med pas ma byas kyang don la sku mdog nag por shugs bstan la go bas chad pa'i skyon med do/ /de dag so so'i kha dog dang rnam 'gyur sogs bshad pa ni/ rtsa zhal ma he khros pa'i gdong / /hūm̐ dang phaṭa gyi sgra chen sgrogs/ /zhes sogs te/ rtsa zhal ma he'i gdong shin tu khros pa'i tshul gyi zhal rab du gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa dang smin ma dang bcas pa/ khro gnyer rim pa du mas 'jigs pa/ shangs 'bud cing zhal nas hūm̐ dang phaṭa la sogs pa drag po'i sgra sgrog pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi rwa sngo sang nge ba bsgom/ de steng gi zhal dmar po khrag 'dzag pa shin tu khros pa ste srin zhal zer bas so/ /de steng 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po cung zad khro ba/ thor tshugs dang / ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon gyi zhal drug 'khor zhal byed na/ rtsa zhal gyi g.yas ngos su zhal gsum mdun nas rgyab du bsgrigs pa'i/

dang po rtsa zhal gyi 'gram nas khro zhal sngon po/ de'i g.yas 'gram nas dmar po/ de'i g.yas 'gram nas ser po/ rtsa zhal gyi g.yon ngos su/ dang po khro zhal dkar po/ de'i g.yon du dud kha/ de'i g.yon du nag po ste/ rgyab ngos kyi zhal gnyis kyi bar du ltag pa cung zad dang bcas pa'o/ /khro zhal bdun po thams cad zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril ba spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing smin ma dang bcas pa khro gnyer bsdus shing snyan gnyis dang bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi zhal rnams snyan gyi rtse mo phrad tsam du bsgrigs pa'o/ /brtsegs zhal byed na/ g.yas kyi zhal ni ma he'i rwa dang rna chog gi 'gram nas g.yas su gzigs pa'i khro zhal sngon po/ de steng dmar po/ de steng ser po brtsegs nas yod pa/ g.yon gyi rwa dang rna chog gi 'gram na g.yon du gzigs pa'i khro zhal dkar po/ de steng dud kha/ de steng nag po rnams brtsegs pa/ thams cad mgrin pa rang sor bzhi bzhi/ khro zhal bdun po gdang shing mche gtsigs ljags 'dril sogs gong ltar 'jam dpal gyi zhal la'ang spyan gsum yod/ zhal 'og ma gnyis kyi ltag pa ma he'i zhal dang 'brel/ steng zhal rnams la ni rang rang gi ltag pa dang bcas pa yongs rdzogs re nges par yod do/ /gzhan dang ma 'drel ba'i mtho brtsegs kyi rnam pa can yin no/ /zhal thams cad kyi dbu skra ser nag gam khams nag 'jam dpal gyi zhal gyi rgyab ngos nas/ yar 'khyil ba'i rnam pa can la ma he'i zhal gyi rwa bar na thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan rin po che'i rtse phran dang bcas pa/ khro zhal bdun la'ang 'dre/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal la rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dang / khro zhal rnams kyi snyan la rus pa'i a long / ma he'i zhal gyi spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor pho drwa mig so gnyis pa'o/ /rgyan drug gi dag pa phar phyin drug dang rgyal ba rigs drug mtshon no/ /gnyis pa phyag gi gyes tshul ji ltar yin pa phyag mtshan dang bcas pa ni/

g.yas pa'i phyag rnams zhes sogs te/ g.yas su bcu bdun dang / g.yon du bcu bdun 'ong bas/ g.yas g.yon gyi mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrigs shing / 'khor ba'i rnam pa can dpungs pa nas phyag mgo'i bar gyi phyag yongs rdzogs so bzhi'o/ /phyag mtshan 'dzin tshul ni/ kha cig steng du 'phyar ba dang / g.yas g.yon du gdengs pa dang / 'og tu brkyang pa sogs ci rigs so/ /phyag mdun ma gnyis gri thod thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin la/ gri gug ni rdo rje rtse lngas yu ba byas pa'o/ /'phang mdung ni/ rgya skad du bi ti pha la ste/ smad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rnam pa la rma bya'i sgro btsugs pa ste mtshon rtse gcig pa yang zer/ gtun shing 'bras sogs rdung ba'i shing dbyibs 'byong mo sked nyag mgo mjug gnyis gtun ril 'dra ba'o/ /chu gri 'dod tshul mang yang / rang lugs la gyong bzo ba'i klog gri ltag 'gyed rdo rje yu ba byas pa'o/ /rdo rje rtse gcig rwa gzhan med pa'i dbus rwa yar mar yod pa'o/ /dgra sta satwa re rnga bo che yu ba'i mgo mjug gnyis su rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'o/ /gzhan rnams sla/ rnge'u chung he ru ka'i chas drug ltar ram/ cang te'u gang rung ngo / /g.yon gyi phyag mtshan rnams ni/ mgo bo ni gdong bzhi pa tshangs mgo bris sku phal cher la snang / gdong bzhi med kyang chog ste 'og tu tshangs pa mnan pa sogs gsung / gzhu'i mchog ma nas 'dzin pa rgyal ba'i brda'o/ /ro ras dur khrod kyi ras la 'phan rtse gsum bzos pa'o/ /me thab gru gsum 'bar ba'o/ /sdigs mdzub phyag gis mdzad pa'o/ /rlung ras rlung la phyar ba'i ras so/ /phyag rgyab ma gnyis kyi glang po che'i lpags pa mgo g.yas mjug ma g.yon du bstan te 'dzin/ bgrang tshul ji ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /phyag thams cad kyi mthil dmar po/ phyag 'gags dang dpung par rus pa'i gdub bu dang bcas pa'o/ /gsum pa zhabs kyi dod tshul ji ltar yin pa srog chags dang bcas pa ni/

zhabs bcu drug po g.yas su brgyad g.yon du brgyad 'ong bas mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrigs pas srog chags re re mnan pa'o/ /srog chags go bla/ gzhung rnams na ming mi gcig pa du ma snang / ri skeg ni skye ga khra mo'am/ mjug ma ring zhing khra bor yod pa bod kyis rgya byar 'bod pa de la bzhed pa gnyis snang bzhad ni bal po sogs na yod pa bya dkar po khrung khrung 'dra ba gcig yod/ srog chags rnams g.yas pa rnams g.yas su kha blta/ g.yon pa rnams g.yon du kha bltas nas mnan pa'i 'og tu bdud bzhi mnan pa'o/ /tshangs pa phung po'i bdud mi gzugs dkar po/ brgya byin lha'i bu'i bdud mi gzugs ser po/ gnyis g.yas kyi gdong gnyan brgyad kyi 'og tu 'gyel nas brdzis pa'o/ /dbang phyug chen po nyon mongs pa'i bdud mi dmar po/ khyab 'jug 'chi bdag gi bdud mi nag po gnyis g.yon gyi gdong gnyan brgyad kyi 'og tu mnan pa'o/ /'dir rwa lo'i dkar 'grel nag 'grel ltar yin no/ /de ltar 'jig rten na che ba'i lha rnams zhabs 'og tu mnan pas 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba mtshon/ rnam pa ni mi gzugs mnan pa bshad pas/ rang rang so so'i gzugs su bsgom mi dgos gsung / ngo bo ni bdud dang bar chad thams cad de dag gi gzugs su byas nas mnan pa'o/ /zhabs mgo rnams la rus pa'i rkang gdub re res brgyan pa'o/ /bzhi pa sku'i rgyan cha ji ltar yod pa liṅga dang bcas pa ni/ mig go khrag 'dzag sogs te/ lnga bcus nang gi khams yi ge ā li kā li lnga bcu mtshon/ sbrul gyi chun pos zhe sdang dbang du 'dus pa mtshon/ mgrin par rus pa'i drwa mig bcu drug pa dang / mdun rgyab tu rus pa'i tshangs skud dang / rkun ma'i skra'i tshangs skud/ sked rgyan drwa mig drug cu rtsa bzhi pa ste/ 'di dag gi bshad pa rje btsun grags pas mdzad pa'i he ru ka'i chas drug gi yi ger blta/ thal chen gyis byugs pa'i steng du skyes pa'i rus pa zhib par btags pa'i phye ma la sor mo lnga bcug nas reg pas/

sngar bas dkar ba'i mtshan ma lnga 'byung ba/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ rang 'byung gi me tog gi thig le ni khrag zhag gi thig le/ zhag chen gyi ri mo gri gug gi dbyibs lta bu bya ba/ zhag gi zo ris te gti mug zhi bar byed/ tshom bus zhe sdang zhi/ thig les 'dod chags zhi/ zo ris kyis srin po sogs dregs pa can 'dul/ tshom bus dregs pa can pho thams cad 'dul/ thig le dregs pa can mo thams cad 'dul ba'o/ /'di dag gzhung mang po nas 'byung ngo / /liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa ni/ nges don 'dzag med liṅga rgyas pa chags pa'i sman/ drang don dbang phyug chen po 'dul ba'o/ /lnga pa gar gyi nyams dgu ji ltar yin pa 'phros pa gzhan dang bcas pa ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba sogs te/ 'di la gsum las/ dang po sku'i nyams gsum ni/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa gsum ste/ sgeg pa ni/ rgyan sna tshogs dang zhal cung zad 'gying ba dang / rnam 'gyur du ma sgeg pa ste/ 'dod chags can 'dul/ dpa' ba ni tshangs sogs bdud bzhi nad brgyad gdon brgyad rnams kyi ngo bo srog chags rnams mnan te sku che zhing brjid pa ste zhe sdang can 'dul/ mi gdug pa ni/ smin ma khro gnyer bsdus shing phyag rnam 'gyur du ma dang ldan pa ste/ gti mug can 'dul/ gsung gi nyams gsum ni/ rgod pa drag shul 'jigs rung gsum/ rgod pa dga' ba'i gzhan sgra ha ha sogs kyi 'dod chags can 'dul/ drag shul hūm̐ phaṭa sogs kyis zhe sdang can 'dul/ 'jigs rung rtag chad 'dzin sogs rmongs chen sad pa phaiṃ gyi sgras gti mug can 'dul lo/ /thugs kyi nyams su/ snying rje rngam dang zhi ba gsum/ snying rje ni sems can thams cad thugs rje chen pos/ yongs su 'dzin par bzhed pa 'dod chags can 'dul/ rngam pa byams pa chen pos gdug pa can la khro bar byed pas zhe sdang can 'dul/ zhi ba stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gis log lta gti mug can 'dul lo/

/sku'i cha thams cad las sprul pa'i pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa phar 'phros nas zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang dang mngon spyod kyi las ji ltar 'os pa mdzad nas slar 'dus te sku'i ba spu'i bu gar 'dus shing thim pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bskyed cing ye shes kyi rang bzhin me ri me dpung 'bar zhing / 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /dbu rnams dang 'tshams pa'i sku lus shin tu che zhing phyag rnams dang 'tshams pa'i sku stod kyang / shin tu rgyas la sgeg cing dod pa dang / zhabs rnams dang 'tshams pa'i sku smad shin tu sbom zhing gsus khyim che la yan lag rnams kyang thung zhing sbom la rags pa zhal dang phyag zhabs de rnams sku dang 'brel chags shing mthun pa yid lam du shin tu bde ba'i rnam pa can mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan zhing bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rgyas par na rwa lo'i bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs su/ go cha'i lha rnams zhal gsum phyag drug par bsgom par gsungs la/ 'god gzhi'i lha zhal phyag mang bas go cha'i lha yang 'di bzhin 'brel chags la/ de tsam mi nus pas 'dir 'phags pa'i gsung bzhin/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs dang / mig byang chub sems dpa'i snying po zhes sogs te/ mig byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po sogs yin pa mos pa tsam yin/ lha'i rnam pa bsgom mi dgos te/ mig sogs tha mal du 'dzin pa'i blo bzlog pa yin/ de yang sbyang gzhi gang yod kyi grangs dang mthun pa bsgom dgos pas sa snying gnyis dang phyag rdor gnyis gzhan rnams re re bsgom/ lus ni dpral ba'o/ /zhal lhag ma rnams la bsgom mi dgos so/ /bsdu na gnas gsum byin rlabs tsam mo/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i dgos pa ni de dag la tha mal gyi rnam rtog las blo bzlog pa dang / bar chad kyi bgegs bsrung ba dang / mngon shes drug 'char ba'o/ /dbang bskur rgyas gdab ye shes pa bzhugs pa rgya bod kyi gzhung rnams su mi 'dra ba du ma bshad kyang /

'dir slob dpon shrī bha tra dang 'phags pa'i gsung star/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros sogs nas gha n+ḍe hoḥyi bar te/ 'di ni shin tu legs te/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i lung sbyor du/ gur las skyes pa 'dul ba pha rgyud bud med 'dul ba ma rgyud yin par bshad pa ltar/ 'jig rten na bu bsam pa ma rdzogs kyang pha'i mnga' ris la dbang zhing / bu mo bsam pa yongs su ma rdzogs bar du mi dbang ba ltar/ pha rgyud thog mar dbang bskur nas ye shes pa phyis 'jug ma rgyud ye shes pa thog mar bcug rjes la dbang bskur byed par bshad pa dang mthun pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na pha rgyud pa rang la de gnyis byung tshe ji ltar snyam na/ ye shes pa dang po bcug nas dbang bskur ba ni/ 'jig rten na rgyal bu nar son par byas nas rgyal sar mnga' gsol ba dang mtshungs la/ dbang bskur nas ye shes pa 'jug pa ni/ nar ma son kyang rgyal sar bskos nas phyis bsam pa rdzogs pa dang mtshungs so/ /zhes so/ /lung 'dir yan lag gsum pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer kha dog lnga pa lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gtso bo rdo rje 'jigs byed bdag gi bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba dang / 'khor rgyas par na zhal gsum phyag drug bsdu na zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma he'i zhal dang ma he'i gdan can/ yum bzhi tsartsi ka dmar mo/ phag mo ser mo phag zhal can/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo/ gau rī ljang sngon/ de rnams la ma he'i zhal dang gdan med/ phyag mtshan rigs bzhi yab dang 'dra/ byang chub sems dpa' drug ma he'i zhal dang gdan can/ byams pa sa snying lta bu/ 'jam dbyangs nam snying lta bu ste brgyad/ gzugs rdo rje sogs drug rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa dang / khro bo bcu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rnams rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/

gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod nas mthar mchod yul gyi gtso bo'i thugs khar thim/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab ste/ tshig rkang dang pos de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi/ gnyis pa khro bo khro mo/ gsum pas sems dpa' dang sems ma la bos nas/ bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad sogs te/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyis gsang ba gsum gyi gnas sam/ rigs las byung ba'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po khams gsum gyi sems can kun gyis phyag byas pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo sbyin pa bya'o/ /zhes pa'i tshigs bcad dang / oṃ ni dpal/ badz+ra u da ka rdo rje'i chu/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi mngon par dbang bskur ba/ su shin tu/ ra ti dga' ba/ satwaṃ khyod/ a haṃ nga'o/ /zhes pa'i sngags gsung zhing / dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad cing byin gyis rlobs/ rdo rje'i tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i yum bzhis bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba zhes sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo bcu'i hūm̐ phaṭa la sogs pa'i bgegs bskrad/ rig ma drug gis/ gzugs sgra la sogs drug po ni/ zhes sogs kyis mchod pa'i glu len cing mchod/ lha thams cad kyis khro bo'i phyag mtshan rnams dang / rus ba'i rgyan drug la sogs pa'i khro bo'i chas rnams kyis dbang bskur te so sor thim/ bum pa'i chu spyi bo nas blug pa tshangs pa'i bu ga nas mar zhugs/ byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis lus kyi nang thams cad rkang mthil yan chad khengs/ dri ma dag dbang bzhi thob ste/ de yang smin mtshams yan chad gang bas lus kyi dri ma dag nas/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang bas ngag gi dri ma dag nas gsang ba'i dbang thob/

snying ga yan chad gang bas sems kyi dri ma dag nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ rkang mthil yan chad gang bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas dbang bzhi pa thob par bsam/ khyad par du sogs te/ chu lhag ma yar spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba las/ srin zhal gyi mdun/ rtsa zhal gyi dpral ba'i steng du bla ma mi bskyod pa rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa rang nyid kyis bsgom pa lta bu chung ngu zhig gis dbu brgyan par bsam/ son shrīs 'di bzhin gsal lo/ /dbu rgyan de'i spyi bor rang rtags rdo rje rtse lnga bsgom mo/ /de lta bu'i dbu rgyan de ni rang la rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur ba'i bla mar mos pa bya/ de la bla ma chos 'brel yod tshad 'dus par bsgom/ bla ma gcig la dam tshig nyams na yang sbal dong gi sbal pa rma can ltar 'gyur bas bla ma rnams la dam tshig ma nyams pa gal che ste/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i mthar thug pa/ /dbu rgyan la ni rigs bdag 'byung / /rigs bdag de ni bla ma yin/ /'di ni gal te 'chol gyur na/ /dngos grub med par rgyud las gsungs/ /zhes sogs lung mang ngo / /yan lag bzhi pa ye shes pa bcug ste sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas lcags kyu zhags pa sogs te/ lha rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros pas lcags kyus lha rnams kyi thugs khar rig pas bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang gi nang du dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis 'gugs par bsam zhing oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ oṃ sngags kyi mgo 'dren/ aṃ gu sha lcags kyu/ dzaḥkhug de bzhin du rdo rje zhags pa'i tshogs spros pas/ zhags pas mgrin par reg pas rang gi smin mtshams nas thim pas bdag la nye bar byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing / oṃ sogs gzhan 'dra/ pā sha zhags pa rdo rje lcags sgrog tshogs spros pas/ lcags sgrog zhabs la reg pas chu la chu 'dres pa bzhin bdag la thim par bsam/

oṃ sogs s+pho ṭa lcags sgrog rdo rje'i dril bu tshogs spros pas/ dril bu'i sgra phyi nang kun tu byung bas dam tshig pa rnams ye shes pa'i ngo bor gyur/ de dag thams cad bdag la mnyes bzhin tu bzhugs par bsam zhing / oṃ sogs ghaṇ+ḍe dril bu'i/ lha de dag gi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni/ gdong drug sgrub thabs de wa ā ka ra tsan+t+ras mdzad pa las/ lcags kyu kha dog dkar po la/ /phyag g.yon dkur brten g.yas brkyang bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /zhags pa kha dog sngon po la/ /phyag g.yon dkur brten g.yas zhags pa/ /g.yon brkyang stabs kyis gnas pa'o/ /lcags sgrog kha dog dmar po la/ /phyag gnyis kyi ni lcags sgrog bsnams/ /sa ga'i stabs su bzhugs pa'o/ /dril bu kha dog ljang khu la/ phyag g.yon dkur brten g.yas dril bu/ /zlum pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ni bzhugs/ /khro bo sgeg pa'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /rgyan kun gyi ni rnam par brgyan/ /zhes gsung so/ /dgra nag ltar yang rung ngo / /sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pa ni/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs te/ rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgom pa dam tshig sems dpa' de'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du 'jam dpal bsgom pa ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs khar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mtshan pa bsgom pa ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rā los 'jam dpal mtshon gang ba/ rdo rje nas tsam gsungs/ 'di rnams thugs khar zer yang snying ga'i nang du yin/ dam tshig phyag rgya gdong drug nas so/ /phyag rgya 'ching tshul zur 'debs na gsal/ gnyis pa mchod pa bya ba ni/ de nas nang mchod sogs te/ go rim rnam grangs mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung yang / dgra nag gi rgyud ltar 'phags pa rin po ches/ bdud rtsis myang ba/ mchod bstod rnams rim par gsungs/ go la sogs pa'i sa bon rnams ni sems can de dag dang bdud rtsi rnams kyi ming yig dang po yin te/

go la ba lang / ku ku ra khyi/ daṇ+ḍa bo ldan te rta/ ha ta glang po che/ na ra mi/ bi ra gshang ba/ mu ra gcin/ shu tra khu ba/ madz+dza rkang / ra ga khrag go /srog chags rnams ni ro'i rnams pa yongs rdzogs re bsam/ yak+ṣe sogs ni gshin rje gshed rigs lnga'i sa bon no/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i kha dog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs su/ go dkar po las ba lang gi sha zhes sogs bshad pas/ ba lang dkar/ khyi sngo/ rta dmar/ glang po che ljang khu/ mi sngo/ bdud rtsis la dri chen dkar/ dri chu ljang / sha chen dmar/ rak+ta dmar ser/ byang sems dkar/ de ltar thob bam snyam pas dpyad do/ /rigs lnga rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang de dag gi yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud yab yum bcu sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa zhu/ kha dog dkar yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs/ saṃ ṭar has ni kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /ho yis ro ni 'jig par byed/ /hrīḥyis nus pa 'jig par byed/ /ces gsungs pas/ kha dog dri ro ngan pa rnams bcom nas bzang por byin gyis brlabs/ myang tshul ni lce hūm̐ las rdo rje bsam pa'i sbu gu nas 'od zer byung ste bdud rtsi drangs te gsol nas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs snying gar bzhugs pa rnams tshim par bsam/ gdong drug gi sgrub thabs ltar na gung mo dang gsang 'dus ltar na mtheb srin sbyar nas bdud rtsi blangs te myang ngo / /'dir g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'bul ba rtsa rkyang ma byang sems 'bab 'dzin byed pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /'phags pas lce la myangs pas/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang bas bde ba chen po skyes par bsam zhing / oṃ sarba sogs gsungs te/ sngags don oṃ ni nor ster ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ a mri ta/ bdud rtsi/ badz+ra/ rdo rje/ swa bha wa/ rang bzhin/ at+ma ko3haṃ/ bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes so/ /rwa los mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa gsum mi dmigs par bsams te sngags brjod par gsungs so/

/gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ thugs kha nas sprul pa'i lha mo sogs te/ gzugs sgra sogs mchod pa'i tshig ni gdong drug gi rgyud las 'byung zhing / de'i don yang / gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg dang / chos te drug po rnams ni/ rang gi rang bzhin dngos po bden par grub pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu yin pa la mig sogs dbang po lngas so sor longs spyod pa'i yul du/ kha dog dbyibs kyi gzugs la sogs pa du mar snang ste shel dag pa la mtshon gang bstan pa de'i kha dog shar ba bzhin du/ sems rang bzhin gyis dag pa bag chags kyi dbang gi du mar snang ba'i phyir ro/ /rnal 'byor pas kyang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang / de'i yul can la sogs pa'i chos thams cad tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas rtag tu zhen pa med par longs spyod par shog cig a la la ho ngo mtshar ba rol du gsol zhes pa mchod pa'i rnam par rol du gsol/ gnas par mdzod cig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gang du'ang mi 'dzin pa sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dod yon la lha'i rnal 'byor dges pa'i gar gyis mchod pa'i tshul du rol bar mdzod/ reg bya dang des mtshan pa'i ro dang dri dang sgra dang gzugs 'gag pa med bzhin du snang ba de la dbyings dang dngos med nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las mi g.yo bzhin du mchod par dgongs te/ rol bar mdzod cig ste/ ho dbyings skye ba med pa'i tshig go /chags pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin chags pa'i tshul gyis bzhes par mdzod ces pa'o/ /de yang gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long thogs pa sgra'i lha mo sngon mo bi waṃ/ dri'i lha mo ser mo dung chos/ ro'i lha mo dmar mo thod pa/ reg bya'i lha mo ljang khu na bza'/ chos kyi lha mo dkar mo chos 'byung thogs pa rnams snying ga nas spros pas/ re re'ang du mar sprul te/ rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor du 'khod nas mchod pa'i glu de dag len bzhin du 'khod par bsam/

mchod bya mchod byed sogs mi dmigs bas oṃ sarba sogs te/ gzhan 'dra/ pu dzā mchod pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /gsum pa bstod pa ni/ lha mo de dag gis bstod par bsam zhing / dur khrod rgyan gyis sogs te/ bstod tshig gdong drug gi rgyud las 'byung / dur khrod rgyan gyis legs par brgyan pa'i zhe sdang gshin rje gshed po rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po ni chos sku dngos po med pa nam mkha' dbyings lta bu'i ngang las ma g.yos par thugs rjes zhe sdang can 'dul ba'i phyir sgyu ma lta bu'i sprul pa'i skur bstan pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can gyi khro bo'i rgyal po dud kha dang / mun pa chen po'i sku can khyod la bstod/ zhes pa ste sngar gyi lha mo rnams kyis tshig de dag brjod pas bstod par bsam/ bstod yul bstod mkhan sogs mi dmigs pas oṃ sarba sogs te sdu ti bstod pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bstod pa'i rang bzhin bstod pa'i bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /mchod bstod byed mkhan gyi lha mo rnams rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas zag med bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes par bsam la/ lha dang dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa dbang po'i gzhu ltar gsal ba la rtse gcig du sems bzung ste mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /gnyis pa de nyid bla med kyi zab gnad gzhan dang sbyar ba la gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed kyi don bshad pa/ de nyams len gyi rim pa la ji ltar sbyor ba'i tshul/ dang po ni/ gsang 'dus las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ /sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags/ /zhes sogs rgyud gzhung mang por tha lam gyi phung khams skye mched thams cad lhar bsgom par gsungs pas/ tha mal gyi snod bcud 'di dag sbyang gzhi dang / lha'i tshogs rnams sbyong byed dang / lha de dang der bsgom pa sbyang tshul dang /

mthar 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su sbyang gzhi de dag sbyong byed de dag gis gnas gyur pa ni sbyangs 'bras yin no/ /de la'ang sems la thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i bag chags 'khor ba bde sdug sna tshogs su snang ba 'di sbyang bar bya'o/ /'o na sems sbyangs pas phyi rol gyi snang ba sbyang gzhir 'gyur ram zhe na 'gyur te/ sems tha mal du snang ba'i rnam rtog gi rgyun 'di ma gtogs pa'i 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gzhan yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por/ sbyong byed lha bsgom pa ni/ de dang rnam pa 'gal ba'i sems yin pas gnyen por 'jog ste/ sems nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo snang bas tha mal rnam rtog gi gnyen po'o/ /gnyis pa de nyid dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs 'di dang sbyar te bshad na bdun te/ sngon 'gros las nyon sbyong tshul/ bskyed chog gi skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul/ lha bsdu bas 'chi srid sbyong tshul/ lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul/ kha dog dbyibs kyis dug lnga sbyong tshul/ phyag zhabs kyis rnam 'gyur gyis mtha' gnyis sbyong tshul lo/ /dang po la bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis sbyong tshul/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyis sbyong tshul/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis sngon gyi las ngan sbyong tshul ni/ 'khor bar yang nas yang du skye ba'i rgyu las nyon gnyis yin/ las la dge sdig lung ma bstan gsum/ mi dge ba'i las kyi gnyen po bsod nams tshogs yin te rigs drug gang rung lus thob dus/ dag dang ma dag yul las bsags pa'i sdig /sbyong byed rang lha'i thugs kha'i 'od zer gyis/ /yi dam spyan drangs phyag mchod rgyun bshags sogs/ /ma dag sems can la bsags sdig pa'i tshogs/ /sbyong byed tshad med bzhi po bsgom pa'o/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs kyis nyon mongs sbyong tshul ni/ nyon mongs rtsa ba lhan skyes ma rig pa/

/gnas lugs spros bral rang ngo ma shes pas/ /nga bdag 'dzin pa nyon mongs kun gyi gzhi/ /de'i gnyen po ye shes tshogs zhes pa/ /sems nyid spros bral don la mnyam 'jog pa'o/ /'dis 'chi srid kyang sbyong ngo / /gnyis pa ni srung 'khor gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag sbyong ste/ 'jig rten pa rnams go gyon sman gtong sogs lus kyi bar chad bzlog pa dang / smyo 'bog sogs sems kyi bar chad bzlog pa'i thabs la rtsol ba byed pa sbyong byed srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rnam par bsgom pas sbyong la bar do'i gnas skabs kyang sbyong ngo / /rten gzhal yas khang la tha mal gyi snang ba spyir sbyong tshul dang / khyad par drag po'i las la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos 'byung gru gsum skye gnas bzhi char gyi snod sbyong ste/ mngal skyes ma'i bha ga sgong skyes sgong lkogs/ rdzus skyes me tog drod gsher skyes gang du skye ba'i sa/ sa gzhi nam mkha' rnams stod rgyas shing smad zhum pa'i rnam par yod pa dang chos mthun rnam thar sgo gsum lam du byed do/ /rlung dkyil khrag mtshos 'og gzhi rlung chu sa rnams sbyongs te/ phyi nang 'byung ba bzhi sbyong tshad med bzhi dang spyan sogs lha mo bzhi lam du byed/ mi mgo'i gzhal yas khang gi 'jig rten mtha' dag sbyong / mdor na rang gi gnas khang lus kyis bar du sbyong / byang phyogs so bdun lam du byed/ gnyis pa ni/ drag po'i las sgrub pa'i skabs su thun khung gru gsum me 'bar ba la sogs pa'i nang du bkug nas rlung me'i dkyil du 'jug pa sogs bsgral las byas skabs 'jigs skrag sogs 'char bar sbyong byed drag po'i gzhal yas khang du bsgom dur khrod brgyad kyis 'jig rten chos brgyad sbyong zhing kye rdor rtsa rgyud las/ dbugs rgyu zhes bya ba'i rigs pa 'dis/ /dur khrod ces ni mngon par brjod/ /ces gsung pas sna bug gnyis gcig tu byas pa'i bug brgyad nas rlung rgyu bas 'khor ba'i rgyu byed pa sbyong /

rgyu sogs dpe brgyad lam du byed do/ /gsum pa bskyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyong tshul ni/ mngon byang dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes/ skabs su a las zla dkyil gyi pha'i khu ba sbyong / dhīḥlas 'jam dpal du bskyed pas bar srid sbyong / thugs kha'i phyi ru āḥlas nyi zlas ma'i rak+ta sbyong / sangs rgyas byang sems sngags phyag mtshan rnams thim pas kyang bar srid sbyong / so sor sbyar na bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum sbyong byed du 'gyur 'dir sngags kyis sgras zhu ba glus bskul yang tshang ngo / /spyir bar srid sbyong tshul mi 'dra ba mang ngo / /mngon byang gnyis pa mnyam nyid ye shes skabs su zla ba 'jam dpal nyi mar 'dres pa'i pha'i khu ba dang dri za gnyis sdongs ma'i mngal gyi khrag la thim nas thig ler gyur pa sbyong / mngon byang gsum pa sor rtog ye shes skabs su hūm̐ yig mthing nag bskyed pa ni/ mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga sbyong ste/ zla ba bcur 'jug pa bcu ni nya la sogs pa yin la gnas skabs lnga ni/ dang po nur nur po/ gnyis pa mer mer po/ gsum pa ltar ltar po/ bzhi pa gor gor po/ lnga pa 'phrang 'gyur rnams 'byung zhing / de dag sdom 'byung las/ mi bskyod gzugs ni nur nur po/ /zhes sogs rigs lngar bshad pas/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu bya ba grub pa/ khog pa so sor rtog pa/ mgo bo mnyam pa nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su bshad pas sbyong ste/ ye shes lnga ni rigs lnga'o/ /'od phung byin po gdan du byas te de la hūm̐ steng du skyes pa ni sgong skyes sbyong byed de sgong skyes la sgo nga phyir lus nas nang nas sems can thon pa'i phyir ro/ /yang mngal skyes la yang mngal gyi phru ma sbyong byed du'ang 'gyur ro/ /mngon byang bzhi pa bya ba grub pa'i skabs so/ /de ltar rkang lag 'gyus pa na zla dgu ngo bcu'i bar la lus yongs su rdzogs pa de sbyong byed hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga rwa gdengs pa des sbyong ste/

steng gi rtse lnga yan lag bzhi mgo bo dang rtse lnga rkang lag bzhi'i sor mo lnga lnga yod pa dang / mgo bo la dbang po yod pa mtshon par/ a bha yas man snyer bshad/ 'di rnams 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa'o/ /mngon byang lnga pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes skabs su/ mngal nas phyir thon pa'i gnas skabs sbyong byed ni 'bras bu rdor 'dzin nyid do/ /snod bcud sbyang ba ni 'phral gyi bya ba gzhan phan sgrub pa sbyong / gnas gsum skye mched byin rlabs kyis tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid sogs sbyong / dbang bskur bas rgyal po rgyal srid dang phal ba rang bzhin 'dzin pa sbyong / ye shes pa bcug sems dpa' sum brtsegs bsgom pas lus sems yongs rdzogs sbyong / de dag gtso cher mngal skyes la sbyar la/ skyes gnas gzhan la sbyar na/ nyi zla drod gsher yin pas drod gsher skyes sbyong / sgong skyes la nyi mas ma zla bas pha mtshon/ rdzus skyes la nyi mas stong pa/ zla bas gsal ba ste/ thams cad la 'jam dpal bar srid sbyong byed/ yang mngon byang phyi ma gsum cho ga gsum bskyed dang mthun pas sgong skyes sbyong la yid kyi lus lhar gyur pas rdzus skyes sbyong ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bsdus pas snod bcud 'jig pa sbyong ste/ snod 'jig pa me chu rlung gsum gyis 'jig pa yin la/ de ni khams gsum snod bcud bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu ba nas gzhal yas khang gdan bcas rang la bsdu ba'i bar gyis sbyong / bcud 'jig pa ni sems can 'chi ba yin pas de ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyong ngo / /des na mngon rtogs kyis dngos gzhi las 'phen gcig gis 'phangs pa'i skye 'chi bar do gsum sbyong ba'i tshe thog mar pha ma'i khu khrag dang bar do gcig tu 'dres pa de nas mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga rdzogs nas phyir btsas pa/ de nas de nyid 'chi ba gsum rim can du 'byung bas sbyong byed la yang gsum po rim can dgos par go rams chen pos gsung /

gzhan yang ye shes tshogs bsag gi 'chi srid sbyong zhing chos sku lam du byed/ rgyu rdor 'dzin 'jam dpal gyis bar do sbyong zhing longs sku lam du byed/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin 'jigs byed kyis 'gro drug gi skye srid sbyong zhing sprul sku lam du byed/ mchod bstod la sogs pas 'dod yon la longs spyod pa sbyong zhing bde ba chen po'i sku lam du byed pa ste/ mi g.yo rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ 'chi ba nyid ni chos su brjod/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bar srid dang / /'gro ba drug gzugs sprul pa dang / /'dod pa'i longs spyod bde chen po/ /sku bzhi yi ni rang bzhin gyis/ /zhes pa'i dgongs par rje rdo rje 'chang bzhed do/ /'di dag bla ma nyams myong can la 'khrid cing nges pa rnyed pa gal che'o/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa lam byed ni/ tshogs gnyis bsags pas thar pa cha mthun nas/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa'o/ /srung 'khor bdud btul pho brang zhing sbyong la/ /lhar bskyed dbang bskur khams gsum chos rgyal 'gyur/ /spro bsdu'i don mdzad bzlas pas chos 'khor bskor/ /dkyil 'khor bsdu bas mya ngan 'das tshul ston/ /spyod lam la sogs mdzad pa 'phrin las so/ /'di ni thar pa'i 'dra 'bag lam du byed pa'o/ /lnga pa lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong tshul ni/ 'dir ni gtso cher khro bos zhe sdang sbyong / /liṅga gyen du langs pas 'dod chags sbyong / /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i skur bsgom gti mug sbyong / /lha kun bsdigs par mdzad pas nga rgyal sbyong / /gar dgu rnams kyis rim bzhin dug gsum sbyong / /drug pa kha dog dbyibs kyis dug lnga sbyong tshul ni/ dkar pos gti mug ser pos nga rgyal dang / /ser sna sbyong zhing sngon pos zhe sdang sbyong / /dmar pos 'dod chags ljang khus phrag dog sbyong / /zhal gyi mdog sogs thams cad de ltar sbyar/ /phyag mtshan ni/

'khor los gti mug rdo rjes zhe sdang sbyong / /rin chen nga rgyal pad+mas 'dod chags sbyong / /rgya gram ral gri la sogs phrag dog sbyong / /nyon mongs so so'i rigs mthun ye shes mtshon/ /bdun pa phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur gyis mtha' gnyis sbyong tshul ni/ phyag zhabs g.yas brkyangs snying rjes sems can don/ /bskum pas bdag nyid thugs rje chen ldan mtshon/ /g.yon brkyangs chos nyid stong pa kun khyab mtshon/ /thugs khar bsnol ba'i phyag dang dkyil krung gis/ /zung 'jug mtshon te mtha' gnyis sbyong ba'o/ /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs sbyar te/ /nga rgyal brten dang rnam pa gsal ba bcas/ /g.yengs skyon spangs te rtse gcig bsgom mdzod dang / /rang gzhan don gnyis myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes nyung ngu'i ngag gis gdams pa'o/ /'phags pa rin po ches/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos kyis tshul/ /sems can khams bzhin bgrang yas las/ /theg pa chen po khyad par 'phags/ /de yi snying po rdo rje theg /gsang sngags rgya mtsho thams cad las/ /las kun bde blag sgrub byed cing / /gdug pa 'dul byed drag po yi/ /las la gshin rje gshed po bsngags/ /de'i tshul yang dpag yas la/ /ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ /khyad par 'phags zhes lung las 'byung / /gtan tshigs kyang ni 'di la snang / /zhes gsungs te/ de yang rnal 'byor pa'i tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i phyi'i bdud 'chi bdag gshin rje yin pas/ de 'dul bar byed pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis rnam 'gyur du ma'i sgo nas rab tu khros pa'i tshul can gyi sku sgom par byed pas 'dul la/ de yang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la bar du gcod par byed pa ma rig pa yin la/ de sems can gyi snying dbus na gnas par bshad pas/ de'i gnyen po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen rab kyi ngo bo rje btsun 'jam dbyangs yin la/ de snying ga'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du bsgom pas ma rig pa drung nas dbyung ba la thabs gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin no//

༈ /gnyis pa mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la drug ste/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gsum sngon 'gro dag pa dran pa/ bzlas ba'i rnal 'byor dngos zhar byung dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'di las rgyas par gtso che bas/ sgrub thabs phal cher na dag pa mi gsal yang / mchog sgrub pa la nges par dgos pas/ so na shrī'i mdor bshad nas 'byung ba'i dag pa dran pa/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa'ang phal cher de dang 'dra ba la li ta'i bstod pa'i 'khur kha cig tu/ dgu pa 'gugs byed lcags kyu 'dzin zhes sogs dag pa dang sbyar ba'ang snang / rwa 'gyur ni dgu pa'i phyag gi lcags kyu sogs snang / mi bskyod ba'i bka' 'grel nas 'byung ba'i dag pa/ rdo rje snying 'grel nas sbas don gyis dag pa sogs shes par 'dod na de dag tu blta/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ra gyi zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs las/ dam pa'i don du rnam dag pa/ /dus ni dpa' bo chen bo'i gzugs/ /zhal brgyad thun tshod spyi yin no/ /phyag dang rwa gnyis zla ba dang / /zla ba phyed dang yang dag sbyong / /zhon pa bcu drug dus dang ni/ /zla ba dang ni zhag tu shes/ /zhal ni gza' dgu dag du shes/ /phyag ni rgyu skar dag dang sbyar/ /zhabs ni 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang / /dus bzhi yang ni de bzhin no/ /mtshon cha rnams ni stong pa dang / /snying rje dag ni bcu drug gnyis/ /glang chen lpags pa bgegs chen te/ /drag po'i gzugs ni sdug bsngal che/ /sel bar byed ba'i gtso bo'o/ /kha dog nag po byams pa che/ /thod pa'i rgyan ni mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor lha ni thams cad dag /rang bzhin 'byung ba'i dus dag go /sngags gsum dag pa sku gsum mo/ /lha rnams nyid kyi rang ming ni/ /dang po oṃ dang hūm̐ phaṭa mtha'o/

/thod pa btung ba'i dus dag go /dkyil 'khor byang chub phyogs yin no/ /zhon pa sa ri sin ti nyid/ /mdog sogs de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ /dag pa thams cad shes pa'o/ /'di ni dag pa cung zad tsam/ /'jam dpal ru na rgyas pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di bzlas pa'i gong du brjod cing don dran par bya/ yang na thun mtshams su brjod cing don dran par bya'o/ /de dag gi don cung zad bshad na/ dus rnam par dag pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi sku'o/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i dus 'khor lo/ /zhes pa dang don gcig thun tshod brgyad dang thun tshod spyi zhal dgu/ /zla ba bcu dang zla phyed nyer bzhi ste/ /so drug ni phyag so bzhi dang rwa gnyis te so drug go /gzhon pa bcu drug ni yar ngo mar ngo'i dus dang zhag bcu drug go /gza' dgu ni nyi ma sogs bdun dang dgra gcan mjug rings dang dgu'o/ /phyag ni rgyu skar rnams dag pa ste/ nyer brgyad ni phyogs re re bdun bdun yod pa'o/ /mtshams skar bzhi dang skar khongs ring thung gnyis te so bzhi dag pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug ni lug glang la sogs pa bcu gnyis dang / dgun sogs dus bzhi ste bcu drug dag pa'o/ /phyag g.yas kyis mtshon cha rnams stong nyid bcu drug mtshon la/ phyag g.yas bcu drug thabs kyis ngo bo yin pas zung 'jug g.yon gyis mtshon cha bcu drug ni yul can snying rje bcu drug mtshon la/ phyag g.yon bcu drug shes rab kyis ngo bo yin pas zug glang lpags ni phyi rol du bgegs chen po bi na ya ka btul ba dang / nang du ma rig pa dag pa'o/ /sdug bsngal chen po sel bas drag po'i gzugs so/ /kha dog nag po ni byams pa chen po'o/ /thod pa'i rgyan ni chos sku de bzhin nyid mi 'gyur ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams ni rang bzhin gyi 'byung ba'i dus rnam par dag pa'o/ /sngags gsum zhes bya ba rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum ni sku gsum dag pa'o/

/lha so so'i rang ming gi dang por oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ phaṭa sbyar ba ni thod par bdud rtsi btung ba'i dus rnam par dag pa'o/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor ni byang phyogs so bdun dag pa'o/ /zhon pa sa ri sin ti ka bsgyur ba mi snang gsungs/ kha dog lnga rnams de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sogs khongs nas de dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan lnga la sogs pa lnga'i ngo bo'o/ /de lta bu'i dag pa rnams go don 'phrod par byed pa ni mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag tu med kha med yin no/ /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum te/ bzlas pa'i yul phreng ba/ ji ltar bzlas pa'i bsam gtan/ bzlas bya'i sngags so/ /dang po ni rtog bdun las dung chen gyi phreng ba gsungs pa/ mi thod las byung ba bsngags/ gzhan las so so'i phreng ba zhi ba la mu tig sogs/ rgyas pa la gser sogs/ dbang la tsan dan byu ru/ drag po la rag sha lung thang sogs/ thun mong du bo dhi tsi nyid/ sngags grangs zhi ba la brgya/ rgyas pa la brgya rtsa brgyad/ dbang dgug la nyer lnga/ mngon spyod la drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /phreng thag dgu bsgril/ sngags bzla zhing rgyu mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs/ zhi ba la mdzub mo'i steng nas bgrangs/ rgyas pa gung mo/ dbang la srin lag drag po mthe chung ngo / /kha dog zhi bar dkar po/ rgyas ser/ dbang dmar/ drag po nag lung rgyud sde mang por gsal lo/ /byin rlabs bya tshul/ bdud rtsi lngas gtor te/ bzlas pa'i sngon du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i zhes sogs zur 'debs ltar ro/ /yang rdo rje 'chang gi gshed mar lung sbyor ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /gnyis pa bzlas pa'i bsam gtan/ de nas thugs kha'i 'khor lo zhes sogs te/ gsal 'debs tshul ni zur 'debs na yod pa de rwa lo sogs kyis yig rnying gi bcud yin pas de bzhin bya'o/ /thun mong ba dkyus ma ni rtog bdun las bshad do/ /'od zer spro bsdu'i 'phrin las bzhi bsgrub tshul sngags rnams las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas rang gzhan gyis sdig sgrib nad gdon zhi bar bsam pa dang /

rgyas pa la 'od zer ser pos tshe dang bsod nams la sogs rgyas par/ dbang la 'od zer dmar/ snod bcud dam gang dmigs dbang du 'dus par/ drag po la 'od zer nag po/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sogs tshar bcad par bsam/ yang na lha'i rnam pa las mthun spro ba'ang rung / dmigs pa de gcig pus skyo na re 'ga' lha dang gzhal yas khang sogs la sems gtad/ res sngags 'khor la/ res sngags ngag tu brjod par sems gtad/ gang ltar sems rgya yan la btang nas sngags bzlas kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung bas sems ma yengs pa ni man ngag dam pa'o/ /gsum pa bzla bya'i sngags ni/ rtog bdun las sngags gsum ka'i sngags btu gsungs/ ya man+ta ka la snying por bshad/ dpal 'dzin rwa lo 'phags pa rnams kyis nye snying du bshad/ bsnyen pa'i sngags grangs sgrub thabs na gsal/ sngags gsum gang mos gtso bor bzla ba sgrub thabs thams cad mthun/ ya mā ra dza ni lha so so'i sa bon yin pas bsgyur du med par bshad la/ ma ti paṇa chen gyi dngos slob lo ts+tsha ba rdo rje dpal gyis tshigs bcad du bsgyur ba snang ste/ gang du gshin rje'i rgyal po rtag par bdag /'dren pa gang zhig bdag la ring du brtse/ /nges par gnod sbyin min gang brtse ba gang / /gang zhig nad med stsol mdzad gnod sbyin la/ /zhes bsgyur/ dus dang gnas skabs gang du gshin rje'i rgyal po rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'dren pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed gang zhig gi bdag dang sems can thams cad dus yun ring po 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du bdag dang sems can thams cad thugs brtse ba can des nges par bdud dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa brtse ba min te/ gdul dka' 'dul ba pos/ gang zhig sems can la rgyu ci zhe na/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / rtag par ldan pa'o/ /des na sgrub pa po gang zhig skye rga na 'chi'i 'jigs pa med pa stsol bar mdzad la/

bdud dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa skrag par mdzad pa de la 'dud do/ /zhes lo ts+tsha ba rdo rje dpal gyis dpal ldan sa skyar bsgyur zhing bshad pa'o/ /zhes 'byung / hrīḥ'aphrog pa ṣ+ṭ+rī za ba/ wi rnam pa/ kri ta byed pa/ a na na zhal/ ya ma gshin rje/ man+ta ka mthar byed do/ /gsum pa zhar byung dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs nas gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gtor ma dang ma 'brel na gnas gsum dang skye mched drug bsrung ba/ dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ oṃ zhes sogs nas blos zin par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ thun mtshams su dran rtog thams cad lha sngags ye shes su dmigs la sdang zhen dang nyam nga med par bya'o/ /'gro 'dug gang byed kyang sems ma yengs par lha bsgom sngags bzla ba slob dpon mi bskyod pas dgra nag gi 'grel par bshad/ der grangs la phan mi dgos zhes pa/ thun mtshams su bzlas pa rnams bsnyen pa'i grangs su mi bzhugs pa'i don de bsnyen pa ni thun bzhi'i sbyor bas stan thog gcig tu ngag bcad byas nas 'gro dgos pas so/ /gsum pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas za ba'i tshe zhes sogs nas mchod pa'i bsam pas za'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /phud mchod chang bu/ za btung byas nas chab len pa rnams sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa yin pas legs par bya/ thun gyi sgang la kha zas rags pa ni mi za ja lta bu btung rgyu byung na byin rlabs sogs 'di bzhin ma chad pa gal che ste/ rwa lo sogs kyi dgra bgegs kyis sha khrag tu bsam gsungs so/ /phan yon ni gsang 'dus bshad rgyud lha mo bzhis zhus las/ rtag par rgyun du zas zos na/ /tshe 'di kho nar 'grub par 'gyur/ /rgas pa med cing nad kyang med/ /zhes sogs mang po gsungs la/ kha zas bu lon can du mi 'gyur ba sogs phan yon che'o/ /bzhi pa nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

nyal ba'i tshe sogs nas bsam la nyal zhes pa'i bar ro/ /lnga pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ ldang ba'i tshe sogs nas 'jug par bya'o zhes pa'i bar te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod snang ba lha dang dkyil 'khor du bsgom mo/ /drug pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma ci 'byor ba sogs nas gnyis su med par thim par bsam la zhes pa'i bar te/ 'byor na tshad med/ ma 'byor na zas kyi zlum gtor yi dam phyogs skyong las gshin rnams la re re ste gsum ma grub na/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la gcig 'jig rten pa la gcig ste gnyis/ chos skyong gzhan la 'bul na/ 'das gtor gyi 'og tu de dag gi gtor ma'ang bshams/ ye ma 'byor na gtor ma gcig gi phud nas 'das pa dang lhag ma gzhan rnams la bsngo/ kyai rdor/ bde mchog mkha' spyod ma rnams la 'bul na 'jigs byed kyi gong du 'bul/ 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed byas nas kyang kyai rdor sogs la 'bul du rung la/ kyai rdor sogs kyi bdag bskyed byas nas kyang 'jigs byed sogs la 'bul du rung / de'i tshe gtor ma byin rlabs bdag bskyed gang byas kyis nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mjug tu gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs kyang rang rang gi sgrub thabs ltar bya ba sogs rnam dbye shes par bya'o/ /'di dag rnal 'byor bla med nang phan tshun gyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ rgyud sde 'og ma dang bsre mi rung ngo / /bya khyung gi phyag rgya/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar/ /khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya/ /zhes bya khyung gi klu'i dug 'phrog pa ltar rdzas kyis dug sel ba'o/ /gzhan dkyus bzhin no/ /phan yon ni la li tas/ bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang / mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi ba dang / /dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gtor mgron gyi dam tshig pa rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs ni rang rdo rje 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs nas yid kun tu bzang po'i bar brjod cing bsam/

dge ba 'di yis sogs dang / sems can thams cad bde gyur sogs kyi mjug tu/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog /ces rwa lo'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung / 'phags pas/ de las byung ba'i dge ba yi/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bcom nas/ /bde ba che la rol bar shog /ces sogs smon lam dang phun sum tshogs pa sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan pa byas la/ gong du bshad pa ltar spyod lam gyis rnal 'byor gsal btab la 'jug de ltar gang bsgom yang sbyang gzhi'i gnyen por bsgom pa dang / lha'i zhal phyag la sogs pa gsal na legs mod/ gal te mi gsal na'ang re shig las dang po pa'i skabs su don spyi gsal ba ma byung yang / tshig gsal ba'i ngang nas rnam rtog gzhan du ma yengs pa gal che'o/ /de yang 'di ltar byas te thun la 'jug pa'i tshe gya tshom du mi 'jug par dang por rang gi sems la rtog dpyod btang ste/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gzhan gyi dbang du song na rgyun bcad de/ skyabs 'gro nas mtshan nyid dang ldan par bya/ de bzhin du bar bar du yang / sems la bya ra yang yang btang ste/ rig pa legs par bcun la/ mjug ma rdzogs kyi bar du ma yengs par byed pa gal che'o/ /mjug tu yang rang gis sems kyi 'jug tshul la legs par brtags te/ sngar gyi rnams nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dbang du song ngam/ sgrub thabs kyi nyams len tshul bzhin du song ma song brtag nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gzhan gyis dbang du song na 'gyod pa bskyed/ phyis de lta bu'i dbang du mi 'gro bar bya/ dge sbyor tshul bzhin du song na zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom/ phyis kyang 'di bzhin du bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang ste/ de yang nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dbang du song ba ma tshor na/

blo la bskyed mi thon pas/ dran 'dzin byed pa gal che ste/ nyams len mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thun gcig byung na'ang thun 'jug la bsam mno btang nas sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i blo bskyed gcig cis kyang yod pa yin pa 'dug pas blo bskyed byung na mtshan nyid par song ba yin/ blo bskyed ma byung na nyams len tshul bzhin du ma song ba'i rtags su shes par byas la/ thun gang nyams su len pa chud ma zos par bya ste/ thun re yang blo bskyed thon pa gal che/ de ltar byas na thun gyi mgo mjug thams cad nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dbang du mi 'gro bar 'gyur/ de'i tshe sbyang gzhi'i gnyen por bsgom pa dang lha'i sku mdog zhal phyag mtshan sogs gsal btab nas bsgom pa yin no/ /de yang las dang po pas thun bzhi bya ste/ srod/ tho rangs/ snga dro/ phyi dro'i thun/ de dag kyang dang por/ drag cing gsal la yun thung ba/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa gnad du che/ /zhes ltar yun thung bar bya/ cung zad brtan nas yun je ring gtong / thun mtshams rnams yang ci nas dge ba'i rtsa bas dus 'da' bar byed dgos mod/ de'i nang nas kyang nyin bar snga thun gyi bar du yang rgyal sras lam bzang la sogs pa dang / gzhan mkho ba'i dpe cha rnams la blta ba gal che/ de ltar dge sbyor gang byed kyang thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du chos chos su 'gro bar byed pa gnad kyi don yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon ni/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhes sogs nas nges pa'o zhes pa'i bar ro/ /sgrub thabs kyis mdzad byang smon lam dang bcas pa ni/ de ltar 'jam dbyangs khro chen sogs nas phan thogs par gyur cig gi bar ro/ /de ltar dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyis sgrub thabs bdud 'joms snang ba zhes bya ba rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i don nyams su len tshul bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi nying khu 'di ni dang por rang gi bla ma mtshungs med chos kyi rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pos bka' gnang yang yun ring du 'gyangs dus phyis rang gi slob ma mdo khams pa shes rab lhun grub kyis nye bar bskul zhing /
